notes.title: Umihara Kawase Fresh! Coming to Switch
notes.content:
Quick bit of news about the newest game in the series which is on its way to Switch

Official homepage:
https://swninfo.success-corp.co.jp/switch/umihara-fresh/

Nintendo store page:
https://ec.nintendo.com/JP/ja/titles/70010000011861

* Degica isn't the publisher, so we can't offer any more information; this is just to keep series fans up to date!

notes.title: Umihara Kawase : Sale and Twitch Event!
notes.content:
IT'S TIME TO FISH!
Now Umihara Kawase is 60% off on Steam!
And if you buy Trilogy, you can even get 70% off for whole series.

Also we will be holding a special Umihara Twitch stream event at 6pm PT on March 29th!
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10204877/a96dea9474fddc74bc6961d11c02b25bbb2c6350.png
https://www.twitch.tv/degigames

Don't miss the chance to ask your questions directly to the developer, Mr. Kondou. The broadcast will be in English with the bilingual streaming idol, kson!
